conditions: Single stationary conducting loop or fixed closed contour; magnetic flux through its spanning surface; loop orientation follows the right-hand rule for surface normal.

evidence: For a stationary closed contour, Maxwell-Faraday gives curl E=-partial B/partial t. Apply Stokes' theorem on a fixed spanning surface and interchange time derivative and surface integral for regular fields. The circulation of E equals the negative rate of change of magnetic flux, with matching orientation.
